option_relations.rationale: The option 'Tumors of the follicular infundibulum (TFI)' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'Tumor of the follicular infundibulum (TFI)'.
Clear cell hidradenoma is a benign adnexal tumor of sweat gland origin, distinct from follicular infundibulum tumors.
Clear cell (pale cell) basal cell carcinoma is a variant of basal cell carcinoma, a malignant epithelial tumor, and is unrelated to tumors of the follicular infundibulum.
Trichoepithelioma is a benign adnexal tumor with follicular differentiation, but it is a distinct entity from tumors of the follicular infundibulum.
